verdict.rationale: smolagents explicitly abstracts model providers, supporting local transformers, ollama, Hub models, and OpenAI/Anthropic/many others via LiteLLM integration, meaning developers swap models via configuration rather than rewriting agent logic. This is documented in the official GitHub README and reinforced by the model-agnostic design shown in code samples (agent = CodeAgent(tools=[], model=model)). missing for 10: no hands-on community report explicitly confirming a live provider swap without code changes.
